title: ‘The Rocky Horror Picture Show’ Coming to Las Vegas’ Sphere
summary: Sphere Entertainment will "enhance" the 1975 cult classic for the massive venue.
contentText:
Rocky Horror Picture Show fans will be shivering with antici…pation for Sphere’s newest movie experience.

The cult classic musical is coming to the Las Vegas venue in 2027 via a special arrangement with Primary Wave Music and 20th Century Studios, Sphere Entertainment announced on Tuesday (June 16). As it did with The Wizard of Oz , Sphere Entertainment says it will use its “advanced technologies to enhance” the original 1975 film for the venue. In the case of the former film, Sphere used AI to expand the film’s visuals to better fit the venue’s curved, 160,000-square-foot screen. It also digitally restored them using an AI-powered “super resolution tool” to render the images in “ultra-ultra-high-definition,” according to Google , which worked with Sphere on the project. Due to the expanded canvas, “composites” of characters were also added to some scenes in which they were originally absent.

“Through Sphere Studios, we are building a slate of original experiences that push the boundaries of technology and storytelling for this new medium, while always keeping the audience at the center of the experience,” said Jim Dolan , executive chairman and CEO of Sphere Entertainment, in a statement. “Since The Rocky Horror Picture Show premiered in 1975, it redefined audience participation and became a cultural phenomenon. With Sphere, we have the opportunity to take that spirit of immersion to an entirely new level.”

Also on Tuesday, Sphere Entertainment announced that The Wizard of Oz at Sphere has now generated more than $400 million in ticket sales, with more than 3 million tickets sold since the experience debuted at the venue on Aug. 28, 2025.
